{{Protagonists}}
{{Quote|Oh! Here's the guy I was telling you about! Alright Listen. This guy ain't Italian and he's no mechanic but he can get things fixed.|[[Joey Leone]] [[Cipriani's Chauffeur|introducing]] Claude to [[Toni Cipriani]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]''.|sound=JoeyLeone-GTAIII-Quote-Claude.ogg}}
'''Claude''' is the [[protagonist]] of {{III}} and a minor character in {{SA}}. He also makes a non-canon [[Rockstar Games Social Club|Social Club]] promotional appearance in {{O}} as a selectable "[[Dad|Special Dad]]" in the [[Character Creator]].

In all of his appearances, Claude never speaks and, as such, doesn't have any official voice actor. His pain sounds, including the ones made by other [[pedestrians]], were voiced by [[Hunter Platin]].

==History==
===Background===
Very little is known about Claude's life. [[Rockstar Games]], however, has stated that by [[2001]], Claude is definitely a drifter, probably from the West Coast, new to Liberty City, with no known family and that his surname may or may not be [[Claude Speed|Speed]].{{Ref|name=lastname|type=rockstarweb|url=https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/19861/grand-theft-auto-iii-your-questions-answered-part-one-claude-dar.html|ref=''"Grand Theft Auto III: Your Questions Answered – Part One (Claude, Darkel & Other Characters)"'' – Rockstar Newswire, December 15, 2011}}

In early 2000 design sketches for Claude by [[Rockstar North]] in ''GTA III: The Game Design Document''{{Ref|name=designdocument2|type=youtube|url={{YT|qUI0moGiNuw&t{{=}}475|''GTA III: The Game Design Document''.}}}}{{Ref|name=items|type=gtaforums|url=https://gtaforums.com/topic/991814-gta-3-design-document-itemized-from-gtaseriesvideos-video/|ref=''GTA III: The Design Document'' itemized from GTASeriesVideos' video on GTA Forums}}, his original description indicated he was intended to be 29 years old. However, all of the character backgrounds and ages listed in the early design document (most notably Maria's background and age) contradict the established canon of the final game and its subsequent prequels.

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
====Racing with Carl Johnson====
{{Quote|Motherfucker! That mute asshole! That fucking snake without a tongue! Gave me this shithole instead of a pink slip? I must be the biggest fucking idiot in the whole fucking world!|[[Carl Johnson]] getting angry at Claude for giving him a run-down garage, in [[Wear Flowers in Your Hair]].|sound=CarlJohnson-GTASA-Quote2.ogg}}
By [[1992]], Claude was a top contender in an illegal racing ring and owned [[Doherty Garage|an abandoned garage]] in [[Doherty (3D Universe)|Doherty]], [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]]. He became involved with [[Catalina]], who had recently split up with [[Carl Johnson]], before [[Farewell, My Love...|racing Carl]] in a losing effort. Following the loss, he hands over his garage to Carl and leaves [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]] with Catalina, heading to [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]].

===Before the events of ''Grand Theft Auto III''===
Catalina and Claude, after leaving San Andreas, begin a nine-year journey to Liberty City, going through many [[United States|American]] states committing bank robberies, including Texas and New Mexico.{{Ref|name=newspaper|ref=''[[Liberty Tree Editorial/Have You Seen This Woman?|"Have You Seen This Woman?"]]'' – Kelly Sue DeConnick, [[Liberty Tree (3D Universe)|Liberty Tree]] ({{URL|http://web.archive.org/web/20070310191501/http://www.rockstargames.com/libertytree/story3.html|Archived website}})}} The two continue on their journey to Liberty City, reaching their destination by October [[2001]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto III''===
====Bank Heist and Jailbreak====
At the start of the game, Claude and Catalina robbed a [[Liberty City Bank|bank]] in Liberty City. Catalina, however, turned on her boyfriend, shooting him and leaving him for dead, justifying her decision with "I'm an ambitious girl, and you're just small time". Claude is arrested by the [[Liberty City Police Department (3D Universe)|Liberty City Police Department]]. He is convicted of all charges and is sentenced to [[2011|ten years]] in [[Liberty City Penitentiary|prison]]. While being transferred to a prison in [[Portland View]], Claude [[Give Me Liberty|escapes]] from a police convoy after the [[Colombian Cartel]] attack the convoy to free the [[Oriental Gentleman]]. Claude and [[8-Ball]] escape to a [[Portland Safehouse (GTA III)|safehouse]] in the [[Red Light District]], before moving on to [[Luigi's Sex Club 7]]. [[Luigi Goterelli]], the owner, gives Claude his first job in the city, to [[Luigi's Girls|drive]] [[Misty]] from the [[Sweeney General Hospital|hospital]] back to the club.

====The Leone Family====
Claude, successful in his errand, continues to be employed by Goterelli, who also has him kill a [[Don't Spank Ma Bitch Up|drug dealer]] and [[Pump-Action Pimp|two pimps]], before having him [[Drive Misty For Me|drive]] Misty to [[Joey's Garage|Joey Leone's Garage]]. Claude then begins to work for Joey, [[Mike Lips Last Lunch|killing]] both [[Mike Forelli]] [[Farewell 'Chunky' Lee Chong|and]] [[Lee Chong]], before [[Cipriani's Chauffeur|chauffering]] [[Toni Cipriani]], later working for him against the [[Liberty City Triads (3D Universe)|Triads]], principally [[Triads and Tribulations|killing three Triads warlords]]. Claude, impressing the [[Leone Crime Family|Leone Family]] hierarchy, is [[Salvatore's Called a Meeting|introduced]] to the [[Boss|Don]], [[Salvatore Leone]]. Salvatore, 'seeing nothing but good things' for Claude, has him [[Chaperone|looking after his 'girl']] [[Maria Latore|Maria]] for the evening, [[Cutting the Grass|kill]] [[Curly Bob]] (who was selling secrets to the [[Colombian Cartel]], now co-led by Catalina) and later [[Bomb Da Base: Act II|destroy]] a [[Les Cargo|freighter]] used as a factory for the [[Drugs|drug]] [[SPANK]]. During this time, Claude also works for [[El Burro (GTA III)|El Burro]], the leader of the [[Diablos]], helping [[Turismo (mission)|him]] [[I Scream, You Scream|on]] [[Trial By Fire|various]] [[Big'n'Veiny|tasks]], and [[Marty Chonks]] in his attempts to get out [[The Crook|of]] [[The Thieves|his]] [[The Wife|various]] [[Her Lover|problems]].

====The Yakuza====
After destroying the Cartel freighter, a paranoid Salvatore [[Last Requests|attempts to kill]] Claude by having him enter a [[Car Bomb|bomb]]-laden [[Cheetah (3D Universe)|car]]. Salvatore's wife [[Maria Latore|Maria]], however, pages Claude and directs him to a small pier where the two meet [[Asuka Kasen]], co-leader of the [[Yakuza (3D Universe)|Yakuza]], and flee to [[Staunton Island]] after Maria had told her husband that she and Claude were an "item". Asuka, unconvinced of Claude's loyalty, has him [[Sayonara Salvatore|kill]] Salvatore Leone to prove himself, before having him [[Under Surveillance|kill a number of other people causing her problems]]. She later introduces him to her brother [[Kenji Kasen|Kenji]] and [[Ray Machowski]], a corrupt police man working for the Yakuza. Claude helps Kenji with his problems, including settling [[Grand Theft Auto (mission)|debts]] and [[Kanbu Bust-out|freeing]] a [[Kanbu|man]] from [[Liberty City Police Headquarters|prison]], and helps Machowski in his attempts to remain unnoticed, eventually helping him [[Marked Man|flee]] the city by the [[Francis International Airport (3D Universe)|airport]].

====Later jobs and The Exchange====
Claude continues to look for work and finds employment with [[King Courtney]], who has him [[Uzi Rider|attack]] the Diablos before [[Kingdom Come|attempting to kill]] him on orders from Catalina, and [[Donald Love]], who has him [[Waka-Gashira Wipeout!|kill]] Kenji Kasen disguised as a Colombian Cartel gangster in a [[Cartel Cruiser]] to provoke a gang war. Asuka, unaware of Claude's role in her brother's death, [[Grand Theft Aero|launches an assault]] on a Cartel-controlled [[Staunton Plaza|building site]] and begins to torture [[Miguel]], co-leader of the Cartel, into giving away Cartel secrets. Armed with the information, Asuka sends Claude on various missions to hurt Cartel operations, including [[Espresso-2-Go!|stopping the selling]] of and [[S.A.M.|stealing]] a shipment of SPANK. Claude briefly finds employment with [[D-Ice]], leader of the [[Red Jacks]] sub-sect of the [[Southside Hoods]], and attacks the rival [[Purple Nines]] into [[Rumble|defeat]]. Claude [[Ransom (GTA III)|returns]] to the building site and finds that Asuka and Miguel are both dead, whilst a ransom note from Catalina, wanting [[Money|$]]500,000 for Maria, is left for him.

Claude goes to the Cartel mansion, [[The Exchange (GTA III)|escapes an ambush, destroys a helicopter piloted by Catalina, thus killing her, and rescues Maria]]. As they depart from the [[Cochrane Dam]] after Catalina's death, Maria starts a long and annoying speech which certainly irritates Claude. Maria's fate is then left unknown as the screen fades to black while she is talking, before a gunshot is fired and she stops talking.

===After ''Grand Theft Auto III''===
What happened to Claude after the events of ''GTA III'' in 2001 is completely unknown. Rockstar Games' official response in [[2011]], on Claude's fate, was that "''He certainly isn’t dead. What else became of him, we don’t know''".{{Ref|name=lastname}}

==Character==
===Personality===
According to Rockstar, Claude was designed as more or less an avatar of the player, leaving much of his character vague on purpose in order for the player to project onto and fill the gaps. But taken at face value, Claude is a calm and serious man who appears almost emotionless regardless of the situation, aside from a slight smirk and usually a glare, seemingly taking everything in stride. Provided he is paid for his services, he will take orders from his bosses without reluctance or complaint, usually giving a nod to show that he understands, and doesn't respond even when he is scolded or shouted at by his bosses for doing something wrong. He also prostrates to his bosses if required, as seen in [[Kenji Kasen]]'s case 

Ironically, [[Catalina]] states that she betrayed Claude for his lack of ambition, and yet throughout the game, Claude works, kills and rises through the ranks of the Liberty City underworld, all just to get his revenge on her. Because Claude never verbalizes his thoughts, it's unclear if he has any true loyalty or respect to anyone. As long as he is paid and it will get him closer to getting revenge, he will work for, and kill, anyone, as evidenced by him [[Waka-Gashira Wipeout!|killing Kenji Kasen]]. He even fights on multiple sides of gang wars, working for the [[Leone Crime Family|Mafia]], the [[Diablos]], the [[Yakuza (3D Universe)|Yakuza]], and the [[Uptown Yardies|Yardies]], completely without hesitation, and goes as far as to orchestrate a gang war between the Yakuza and the Colombian Cartel along with [[Donald Love]].

It should be noted that when Claude does kill one of his former bosses, it's usually those who mistreat him or betray him like Kenji or [[Salvatore Leone]], implying that Claude doesn't take slights against him lightly, explaining why he is more than willing to kill them. His vindictive side is further evidenced when he [[Grand Theft Aero|coldly leaves]] [[Miguel]] to be tortured by [[Asuka Kasen]], for his part in Catalina's betrayal. He does appear to at least have an amicable relationship with Asuka and [[Maria Latore]], since the former is willing to help Claude in his pursuit of revenge against Catalina, while the latter saved Claude's life by warning him of [[Last Requests|Salvatore's trap]]. Despite this, he shows no concern or empathy when finding Asuka murdered by Catalina, completely ignoring her dead body and focusing solely on the [[Ransom (GTA III)|ransom note]] left behind.

For the vast majority of the game, Claude is taciturn and never speaks. He will only make a slight grunt when he is hurt, or an "Oh!" whenever he drowns, gets shot, run over, or when he falls down. He may also give passing vehicles the middle finger when crossing the road. There are moments where despite not talking, Claude will let his actions or behaviour speak for him, such as appearing taken aback and flinching slightly when Kenji yells at his face, or visibly reacting in surprise when Maria tells him that she told Salvatore that they slept together, the aforementioned leaving Miguel to his fate, and seemingly attempting to intimidate [[Carl Johnson]] when the latter has an argument with Catalina over a racing prize.

Claude remains true to his mission of finding and taking revenge on Catalina for leaving him for dead, even showing the slightest bit of pity for Maria when he allows her to live after freeing her and that saving her was at least part of his priorities, only to possibly kill her himself. It's also clear that Claude is primarily out for himself and will use people for his own ends or benefits until he no longer sees a reason to use them anymore; which more often than not ends with Claude killing or abandoning them.

Worth noting is that Claude may possess a simple, almost childish sense of humor. In all of the missions given by Kenji, Claude engages in the preemptive bow with great enthusiasm, so much so that, during the final mission, he does it without even realising Kenji is yelling at him. Likewise, in ''GTA San Andreas'', he's shown some degree of enjoyment in making CJ feel uncomfortable in his presence.

===Appearance===
Claude is a tall Caucasian male in his late twenties to early thirties. He has a somewhat muscular build with brown hair and a faint 5 o'clock shadow. The design document describes him as being a 5′9″ (1.75m) American, of 29 years of age and with a ‘mole on [his] arse’ as his distinguishing feature.{{Ref|name=designdocument3|
type=youtube|url={{YT|qUI0moGiNuw&t{{=}}2165|''GTA III: The Game Design Document''.}}}} He almost always wears a black leather bomber jacket with bronze zippers with a black T-shirt underneath, green cargo pants and blue sneakers. During [[Give Me Liberty]], Claude wears a baggy orange prison jumpsuit with rolled-up sleeves.

In the [[Personal Computer|PC]] version of ''GTA III'', the player can access the options menu and modify Claude's appearance via the player setup option where '''Playa2''' can be selected. Upon selection, Claude's appearance changes to a simple re-texture of his regular appearance. He now has a mustache and a goatee and wears a brown leather jacket with light blue jeans and white sneakers. Aside from that, Claude is one of the few 3D-era protagonists (along with [[Mike]]) that wears the same clothes throughout the entire game.

Claude's appearance in ''GTA San Andreas'' is very similar, though he has a more youthful and detailed face. He is clean-shaven and his hair is styled almost exactly like it was in ''GTA III''; however, his long sideburns are missing.

His clothes consist of a re-skinned black biker jacket with a black T-shirt, olive cargo pants and white and black sneakers.

His appearance in ''Grand Theft Auto Online'' as a parent for the online character is significantly different from his previous counterpart. Like in ''San Andreas'', he is clean-shaven and has a slightly pale complexion. He wears a black leather jacket with a black T-shirt underneath. The jacket, however, is slightly different from its previous renditions. His hair, instead of the usual spiky fringe, is instead styled into a faux-hawk. His face has been structured into a perpetual frown, with a stiff, grumpy brow. Additionally, when chosen as a parent, if players choose to have their character resemble him more, they can, in spirit, play as a customizable "pseudo-Claude" in ''GTA Online'', who can wear any outfit or hairstyle they choose for him.

==Trivia==
*The name "Claude" does not appear in {{III}}. Other characters call him by his nicknames (similarly to [[Claude Speed]], the protagonist of {{2}}) and the menu lines refer to him as 'player'. However, in the ending cutscenes of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas'', when [[Catalina]] is phone calling the protagonist [[Carl Johnson|CJ]], she shouts "Oh, Claude!" with background moaning, indicating Claude and Catalina were having sex. 'Claude' can also be found in the ''GTA III'' game files, suggesting it could have been planned to be in the main game. Lately, Rockstar used the name in many promotional releases related to previous games, such as the game's 10 years anniversary, which definitely confirmed that his name was indeed Claude.
*Originally, he was supposed to be 29 years old in ''GTA III'', but this was ultimately scrapped.
*Even though he never speaks, he grunts in ''GTA III''. They were provided by [[Hunter Platin]]. It is unknown, however, who provided his motion capture.
[[File:Secrets&EasterEggs-GTAIV-RIPGraffiti3DUniverseTribute.jpg|thumb|"Rip Claude" is to the left.]]
*In {{IV}}, his and other {{3D}} [[protagonist]]s' names (excluding [[Mike]]) are written on a wall of graffiti with "rest in peace" messages, suggesting they could all have died after the events in the 3D universe (or this may be also a reference to the end of the 3D era). According to [[Rockstar Games|Rockstar]], this only served as a "little joke to [their] fans".
*In ''Grand Theft Auto IV'', if [[Niko Bellic|Niko]] kills [[Playboy X]] and gains access to his safehouse, he will gain access to Claude's clothes which can only be equipped at said safehouse.
*Claude and the {{GTAOP}} are two of the few characters in the ''GTA'' series who do not speak (excluding any of the optional protagonists from the {{2D}}). This was a choice Rockstar Games made at the start of the development process, as they stated, "We had so many other problems to solve and this did not seem like a major issue." Having a silent protagonist would also help players identify with the character. However, there were rumors that Claude actually spoke in the beta ''GTA III'' trailer, briefly saying "Get out of the car!"; Rockstar replied to the rumors, stating that the voiceover was fake.{{ref|name=getoutofthecar|type=rockstarweb|ref={{Quote|This is fake. This is an old bit of gameplay footage, for sure, but we think the voices were added at a later date by someone online as at no point did we plan for Claude to have a voice or even design how a speaking protagonist would be implemented until Vice City.|{{URL|https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/51974aa3a99a59/grand-theft-auto-iii-your-questions-answered-part-one-claude-dar.html|Grand Theft Auto III: Your Questions Answered – Part One (Claude, Darkel & Other Characters)}}}}}}
**This voice line originates from the .RAW files from ''Grand Theft Auto 2'', played whenever a carjacker steals a random car.{{fact}} As the file is tied to the carjacking animation rather than a specific pedestrian sprite, the audio may also play when the player themselves steal a car. 
**Also, the original line was "Get out of the car, man!", but in the trailer, the word "man" was omitted.
*In the opening cutscene of the game, at the first mission, [[Give Me Liberty]], (notably when he rounds the corner and finds Catalina pointing two pistols at him), Claude's face is notably different in the convoy and onwards (the difference can actually be seen in the gallery of this article). This is because he uses a different model and slightly different texture, likely a beta model.
*In ''GTA San Andreas'', Claude is wearing substitutes for the bomber jacket, cargo pants and sneakers. He is wearing a [[San Andreas Bikers|biker]] jacket that is available from [[Victim]], black hi-tops from [[ProLaps (3D Universe)|ProLaps]], and re-colored olive pants from [[Binco (3D Universe)|Binco]].
*To celebrate ''GTA III''{{'}}s 10th anniversary on October 22nd 2011, Rockstar Games released an official Claude action figure in association with {{URL|http://www.sideshowtoy.com/|Sideshow Collectibles}}. The figure comes complete with both of Claude's outfits (his standard outfit and prison uniform), along with several weapons to pose him with. Only 1600 were produced, and by mid-2012 they officially sold out. Unopened sets can now fetch up to US$2000 on internet auction sites.
*Going by the release date of the games, he is the first protagonist of the 3D Universe, although he is the last chronological one. 
*If one examines Claude's 3D model from ''Grand Theft Auto III'' in a third party program, several peculiar details can be seen. His mouth is asymmetrical and has a permanent sneer. Additionally, the edges and faces that comprise the spikes in his hair aren't properly attached to one another.
*Despite having an in-game pedestrian model in ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas'', the game uses [[Wu Zi Mu|Woozie]]'s character model outside cutscenes and his in-game model is unused for no reason and can be found in the game files.{{Ref|name=model|type=screenshot|image=Claude-GTASA-WoozieModel.png|imagesize=200px}}
*In the ''Definitive Edition'' of ''GTA San Andreas'', Claude's character model is the same as his model in the ''Definitive Edition'' of ''GTA III'', and is no longer an updated model of his original ''GTA San Andreas'' appearance.{{Ref|name=mobilede|type=screenshot|image=Claude-GTASAde-MobileVersionAppearance.jpg|imagesize=200px}}
